description: This PHP source file defines the class JobCategoryMenuConfigurator within the OrangeHRM Admin Menu namespace. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and uses a trait for module screen helper functions. The primary method configures the screen by overriding it to 'jobCategory'.

classes.name: JobCategoryMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu for the job category screen within the admin module, overriding current screen to 'jobCategory'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen context to 'jobCategory' using a trait method and returns null.
